text:
Omar K: Noticed oddness in console: some tenants show two route labels for same request id.
Priya S: Can you paste an example header dump?
Omar K: header: X-Route-Meta: compact=org:app:svc;X-Route: legacy=org/app/svc (both present).
Priya S: Ah the new compact header and older X-Route are both being sent by chained clients -> proxy shim also injects X-Route when missing.
Jules T: That matches our canary logs. Shim didn't check for compact header and blindly injected.
Omar K: Impact: dashboard metrics double-count traffic and quota attribution flips unpredictably.
Priya S: Short term: make ingestion prefer compact header when present and annotate event with route_meta_source.
Jules T: Agree. Also add proxy feature flag skip-inject-if-compact to avoid further injections.
Lina-bot: deploy-bot: proxy-canary scheduled us-west-2 at 1788890000
Omar K: Need audit so finance can reconcile previous spikes; add boolean field route_preferred_source in events and retain raw headers for 48h.
Priya S: I'll open console parser PR to accept the new field and add a tiny tile showing "only legacy / only compact / both" ratios.
Jules T: I'll own proxy change and canary rollout. Plan: canary today, wide roll tomorrow if stable.
Omar K: Also flagging SDK teams: we should doc the compact header and timeline to deprecate legacy in 6 weeks. Devex ping incoming.
Priya S: Noted. I'll coordinate banner text and customer comms with product.
Omar K: Thanks team. Follow-up: post canary metrics in this thread.
